comments: 3971cbba: ;Build DGJTPAR variable to hold revised UNCOMPLETED BY DATE values.
75b6f265: ;If record has a DATE/TIME subfield, store it in DGJTNODT.
c1dfe959: ;Get current date/time in FileMan internal format and store in DGJTNOW.
514bf937: ;Process if the record status is one of interest.

830eb231:  ;If record status is INCOMPLETE, set DGJTFLAG to 1 if the
 ;number of days since the DICTATED DATE exceeds the
 ;UNCOMPLETED BY DATE parameter. Call DAYS^DGJTUDIS to
 ;get the number of days overdue if DGJTFLAG is set.

7fd11e82:  ;If record status is DICTATED, set DGJTFLAG to 1.
 ;Call DAYS^DGJTUDIS to get the number of days since
 ;the DICTATED DATE.

34ccf893:  ;If record status is TRANSCRIBED, set DGJTFLAG to 1 if
 ;the number of days since the DATE/TIME subfield value
 ;exceeds the UNVERIFIED BY DATE parameter. Call
 ;DAYS^DGJTUDIS to get the number of days overdue if
 ;DGJTFLAG is set.

f7bc5aff:  ;If record has a SIGNATURE DATE and the UNSIGNED BY DATE
 ;parameter is non-zero, set DGJTFLAG to 1 if the number
 ;of days since the SIGNATURE DATE exceeds the UNSIGNED BY
 ;DATE parameter. Call DAYS^DGJTUDIS to get the number of
 ;days overdue if DGJTFLAG is set.

7729c9c8:  ;Compute the number of days between two dates and
 ;store in DGJTDL.
